subject: Geofence certification evidence request — dedicated deployment
messages:
From: Nora Patel <nora.patel@fintrust.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: FinTrust Security Team <security@fintrust.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: geofence certification evidence for Dedicated deployment

Hi Lukas,

Hope you’re well. As part of our vendor onboarding checklist we need evidence that the dedicated cluster we contracted with Redwood is region-anchored and that tenant data (including backups and snapshots) does not leave the agreed AWS us-east-1 boundary. Specifically, please provide the following by EOD 2026-12-08: 

1) A small checklist (or one-page summary) describing how region pinning is enforced and audited for our tenant.
2) A snapshot or config export showing the tenant's assigned region and cluster binding (date-stamped).
3) Proof that automated backups/snapshots are stored only in us-east-1 and encrypted at rest; include storage bucket ARNs if possible.
4) Recent run logs or an ops-runbook excerpt that shows the tenant purge/wipe procedure and a sample wipe run (if available).
5) Any attestation or short letter you can provide that states Redwood’s commitments for region residency and deletion for our Dedicated deployment.

We can accept redacted artifacts for anything that contains internal IPs/hostnames. Let me know if you need the request formalized as a doc and who on your side will own the artifacts.

Thanks,
Nora
Nora Patel
Head of Security Operations
FinTrust Bank
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@fintrust.com>
Cc: FinTrust Security Team <security@fintrust.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: geofence certification evidence for Dedicated deployment

Hi Nora — thanks for the clear list. We can provide all five items. Quick clarifying questions before we assemble: 

- For backups/snapshots, do you require separate proof for point-in-time copies older than 90 days or is a current retention matrix sufficient?
- Do you need KMS/HSM access logs (key usage) or is a statement that CMK usage is enforced sufficient?

I’ll coordinate with Ops and Security on our side; can we aim to deliver an initial bundle by Friday 2026-12-04 and the notarized attestation the following week if required? Attaching a checklist template I plan to use.

Regards,
Lukas Meyer
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
lukas_meyer@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

Forwarding FinTrust request — please see Nora's list below (quoted). Need someone to own artifact generation and one person to sign the attestation. Can we split tasks?

On Tue, 1 Dec 2026 at 09:12, Nora Patel <nora.patel@fintrust.com> wrote:
> Hi Lukas,
> 
> Hope you’re well. As part of our vendor onboarding checklist we need evidence that the dedicated cluster we contracted with Redwood is region-anchored and that tenant data (including backups and snapshots) does not leave the agreed AWS us-east-1 boundary. Specifically, please provide the following by EOD 2026-12-08: 
> 
> 1) A small checklist (or one-page summary) describing how region pinning is enforced and audited for our tenant.
> 2) A snapshot or config export showing the tenant's assigned region and cluster binding (date-stamped).
> 3) Proof that automated backups/snapshots are stored only in us-east-1 and encrypted at rest; include storage bucket ARNs if possible.
> 4) Recent run logs or an ops-runbook excerpt that shows the tenant purge/wipe procedure and a sample wipe run (if available).
> 5) Any attestation or short letter you can provide that states Redwood’s commitments for region residency and deletion for our Dedicated deployment.
> 
> We can accept redacted artifacts for anything that contains internal IPs/hostnames. Let me know if you need the request formalized as a doc and who on your side will own the artifacts.
> 
> Thanks,
> Nora

Kimberly — can you own 1, 2, and 4? Please generate the data-plane snapshot and the tenant-wipe log (we can run a dry-run on a dev tenant and provide logs if we need to redact). Karthik — can you confirm the backup storage ARNs and encryption details (3) and draft the attestation language for me to sign?

Kimberly Park (internal):
- ACK. I’ll export the tenant config (k8s annotations + assignment metadata) and produce a dated tarball: pinning-snapshot-2026-11-30.tar.gz. I’ll also populate the checklist template and include a short ops excerpt for the purge workflow. Target: 2026-12-03 EOD.

Karthik Iyer (internal):
- Backups: All automated snapshots for Dedicated tenants are retained in the same region by default. We have S3 bucket ARNs scoped to us-east-1 for this cluster: arn:aws:s3:::redwood-dedicated-us-east-1-backups and arn:aws:s3:::redwood-dedicated-us-east-1-snapshots (I will redacted the full account ids in the artifact). Encryption: AES-256 at rest; customer-managed keys are supported — indicate whether FinTrust used a CMK. I’ll draft attestation language and include a small note on chain-of-custody for snapshot replication jobs.

I’ll attach the preliminary artifacts once done.

— Lukas
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@fintrust.com>, FinTrust Security Team <security@fintrust.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 15:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: geofence certification evidence for Dedicated deployment

Hi Nora — delivering the initial bundle requested. Attachments included (redacted where appropriate):

- geofence-certification-checklist.xlsx — completed checklist mapping each FinTrust ask to the artifact provided.
- pinning-snapshot-2026-11-30.tar.gz — tenant assignment export and cluster binding (redacted hostnames).
- tenant-wipe-log-2026-12-03.txt — dev dry-run of the tenant purge with timestamps and job ids.
- attestation-fintrust-2026-12-04.pdf — short attestation letter signed by Redwood Security Ops lead (redwood-sigs).

Summary of key points:
- Region isolation: The Dedicated cluster hosting FinTrust is pinned to AWS us-east-1. We do not route tenant data to other regions as part of standard operations.
- Backups and snapshots: Automated snapshots are written to S3 buckets scoped to us-east-1 (ARNs referenced in the backup manifest inside the snapshot artifact). Snapshots are encrypted at rest (AES-256) and we support CMK-based encryption upon request — please confirm if FinTrust will provide a CMK.
- Wipe/purge: The included run log shows a dry-run purge on a dev tenant; the runbook excerpt describes the multi-step purge (evict, zero out KV cache, delete object stores, remove snapshots). We can coordinate a supervised production purge if you require a live proof run.

If you’d like, Karthik and I can join a short call to walk through the artifacts and answer any questions next week.

Thanks,
Lukas Meyer
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
